# Data

```{r}
simba_modeldata <- readRDS("../DerivedData/simba_modeldata.rds") %>% 
  filter(pet != "sub-C32_ses-1") %>% # Noted as looking weird (note Granville)
  filter(pet != "sub-C32_ses-2") %>% # Noted as looking weird from images
  filter(pet != "sub-C58_ses-1") %>% # Chopped off CBL
  filter(pet != "sub-C56_ses-2") %>% # Noted as looking weird from images
  filter(pet != "sub-C31_ses-2") # Extremely high TAC: weird from data def report

simba_modeldata_sub <- simba_modeldata %>% 
  filter(pet != "sub-C32_ses-1") %>% # Noted as looking weird (note Granville)
  filter(pet != "sub-C32_ses-2") %>% # Noted as looking weird from images
  filter(pet != "sub-C58_ses-1") %>% # Chopped off CBL
  filter(pet != "sub-C56_ses-2") %>% # Noted as looking weird from images
  filter(pet != "sub-C31_ses-2") %>% # Extremely high TAC: weird from data def report
  filter(sub == "C03" | sub == "C06" | sub == "C11"| sub == "C38"| sub == "C50"
         | sub == "C13"| sub == "C26"| sub == "C47"| sub == "C52"| sub == "B26"
         | sub == "B06"| sub == "C33"| sub == "B20"| sub == "C42")  # 5 of each HAB,MAB,LAB (C33 has two measurements)
```

```{r}
habs <- simba_modeldata %>% filter(genotype=="MAB")
```

# STAN Models

## 3TC5K
* threetc5kND_log_stan : 
* threetc5kND_log_stan_BPp : 
* threetc5kND_log_stan_mix : Mixture model variant
* threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp

for S and P the same
all included into one Stan block that i do not get issues with pointers in the wrong direction

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=6}
three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan <- "

real Integral_Feng_3TC5K(real time, real A, real B, real C, 
                       real alpha, real beta, real gamma, 
                       real Th1, real Th2, real Ph1, real Ph2, real Ph3) {
     
    real integ;
    
    integ = (B*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph3)/alpha^2 + (C*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph3)/alpha^2 + (A*(-1 + exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph3)/alpha^3 + 
  (B*(-1 + exp(-(beta*time)))*Ph3)/beta^2 + (C*(-1 + exp(-(gamma*time)))*Ph3)/gamma^2 + (A*Ph3*time)/alpha^2 - (B*Ph3*time)/alpha + (B*Ph3*time)/beta - 
  (C*Ph3*time)/alpha + (C*Ph3*time)/gamma - (A*Ph3*(1 - (1 + alpha*time)/exp(alpha*time)))/alpha^3 - (A*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph1)/(alpha*(alpha-Th1)^2) - 
  (A*Ph1*(1 - (1 + alpha*time)/exp(alpha*time)))/(alpha*(alpha-Th1)^2) + (B*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph1)/(alpha*(alpha - Th1)) + 
  (C*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph1)/(alpha*(alpha - Th1)) + (A*(1 - exp(-(time*Th1)))*Ph1)/((alpha-Th1)^2*Th1) - 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(time*Th1)))*Ph1)/((alpha - Th1)*Th1) - (C*(1 - exp(-(time*Th1)))*Ph1)/((alpha - Th1)*Th1) + (B*(1 - exp(-(time*Th1)))*Ph1)/((beta - Th1)*Th1) + 
  (C*(1 - exp(-(time*Th1)))*Ph1)/((gamma - Th1)*Th1) + (A*Ph1*(1 - (1 + alpha*time)/exp(alpha*time))*Th1)/(alpha^2*(alpha-Th1)^2) + 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(beta*time)))*Ph1)/(beta*(-beta + Th1)) + (C*(1 - exp(-(gamma*time)))*Ph1)/(gamma*(-gamma + Th1)) - 
  (A*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph2)/(alpha*(alpha-Th2)^2) - (A*Ph2*(1 - (1 + alpha*time)/exp(alpha*time)))/(alpha*(alpha-Th2)^2) + 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph2)/(alpha*(alpha - Th2)) + (C*(1 - exp(-(alpha*time)))*Ph2)/(alpha*(alpha - Th2)) + 
  (A*(1 - exp(-(time*Th2)))*Ph2)/((alpha-Th2)^2*Th2) - (B*(1 - exp(-(time*Th2)))*Ph2)/((alpha - Th2)*Th2) - (C*(1 - exp(-(time*Th2)))*Ph2)/((alpha - Th2)*Th2) + 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(time*Th2)))*Ph2)/((beta - Th2)*Th2) + (C*(1 - exp(-(time*Th2)))*Ph2)/((gamma - Th2)*Th2) + 
  (A*Ph2*(1 - (1 + alpha*time)/exp(alpha*time))*Th2)/(alpha^2*(alpha-Th2)^2) + (B*(1 - exp(-(beta*time)))*Ph2)/(beta*(-beta + Th2)) + 
  (C*(1 - exp(-(gamma*time)))*Ph2)/(gamma*(-gamma + Th2));
   
   return(integ);
                       
}


real threetc5kND_log_stan_BPp(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, 
                    real logk4, real logk5, real logvB, real time,
                    real t0, 
                    real A, real B, real C, 
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;
    
    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real tcorr;
    
    real pred;
    

    
    K1 = exp(logK1);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    vB = exp(logvB);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    
    k2 = K1 / Vnd - k5;
    k3 = (k4 * (k2 + k5) * BPp)/K1;
    KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5);

    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2+k5)));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2+k5)));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - Th1) - KI * Th2)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) + KI * Th1)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    tcorr = time - t0;
  
  pred =  // 2TC contribution
          (1-vB) * (
            (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0
              
              // Before t0+ti
              (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(     
                Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
              ) +
                
              // After t0+ti 
              (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (   
                Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
                  Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
              )
            )
          ) +
          // Blood contribution
          vB*bloodval;
       
  return(pred);
}

// S

real threetc5kS_log_stan_BPp(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, 
                    real logk4, real logk5, real logvB, real time,
                    real t0, 
                    real A, real B, real C, 
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;
    
    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real tcorr;
    
    real pred;
    

    
    K1 = exp(logK1);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    vB = exp(logvB);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    
    k2 = (K1 - k5 * BPp)/Vnd;
    k3 = BPp * (k4 + k5)/Vnd;
    KI = K1 * k3 * k5 / (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5);
  
    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5)));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5)));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - Th1) - KI * Th2)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) + KI * Th1)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    tcorr = time - t0;
  
  pred =  // 2TC contribution
          (1-vB) * (
            (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0
              
              // Before t0+ti
              (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(     
                Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
              ) +
                
              // After t0+ti 
              (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (   
                Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
                  Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
              )
            )
          ) +
          // Blood contribution
          vB*bloodval;
       
  return(pred);
}


// P

real threetc5kP_log_stan_BPp(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, 
                    real logk4, real logk5, real logvB, real time,
                    real t0, 
                    real A, real B, real C, 
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;
    
    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real tcorr;
    
    real pred;
    

    
    K1 = exp(logK1);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    vB = exp(logvB);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    
    k2 = K1 / Vnd;
    k3 = (k4 * BPp)/Vnd;
    KI = k5;
  
    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4)^2 - 4 * k2 * k4));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4)^2 - 4 * k2 * k4));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 - Th1))/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4))/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    tcorr = time - t0;
  
  pred =  // 2TC contribution
          (1-vB) * (
            (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0
              
              // Before t0+ti
              (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(     
                Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
              ) +
                
              // After t0+ti 
              (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (   
                Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
                  Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
              )
            )
          ) +
          // Blood contribution
          vB*bloodval;
       
  return(pred);
}
                    
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
//
// mixture models
//
//

real threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, real logk4,
                    real logk5, real logvB,
                    real logBPpdiff, real logk4diff, real logk5diff,
                    real prophigh, real proplow,
                    real time,
                    real t0,
                    real A, real B, real C,
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;

    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real Th1low;
    real Th2low;
    real Ph1low;
    real Ph2low;
    real Ph3low;

    real tcorr;

    real predhigh;
    real predlow;
    real pred;
    
    real BPplow;
    real k4low;
    real k3low;
    real k5low;
    real KIlow;
    real k5mean;
    

    K1 = exp(logK1);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    vB = exp(logvB);

    // High
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    
    // Low
    BPplow = exp(logBPp + logBPpdiff);
    k4low = exp(logk4 + logk4diff);
    k5low = exp(logk5 + logk5diff);
    
    // Assumed to be indepenpendent of genotypes
    // note for myself: same no mather if mean(k5) or mean(k2)
    k5mean = (k5 +k5low)/2;
    k2 = K1 / Vnd - k5mean;

    // High
    k3 = (k4 * (k2 + k5) * BPp)/K1;
    KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5);

    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2+k5)));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2+k5)));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - Th1) - KI * Th2)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) + KI * Th1)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    
    // Low
    k3low = (k4low * (k2 + k5low) * BPplow)/K1;
    KIlow = K1 * k5low / (k2 + k5low);
    
    Th1low = 0.5 * (k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low - sqrt((k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * k4low * (k2 + k5low)));
    Th2low = 0.5 * (k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low + sqrt((k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * k4low * (k2 + k5low)));

    Ph1low = (K1 * (k3low + k4low + k5low - Th1low) - KIlow * Th2low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph2low = (K1 * (Th2low - k3low - k4low - k5low) + KIlow * Th1low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph3low = KIlow;
    

    tcorr = time - t0;

  predhigh =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC off CND
      
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2,Ph3)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
        )
      ) 
      
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;
  
  predlow =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        )
      )
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;

  pred = ( prophigh * predhigh ) + ( proplow * predlow );

  return(pred);
}
                    
real threetc5kS_log_stan_mix_BPp(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, real logk4,
                    real logk5, real logvB,
                    real logBPpdiff, real logk4diff, real logk5diff,
                    real prophigh, real proplow,
                    real time,
                    real t0,
                    real A, real B, real C,
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;

    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real Th1low;
    real Th2low;
    real Ph1low;
    real Ph2low;
    real Ph3low;

    real tcorr;

    real predhigh;
    real predlow;
    real pred;
    
    real BPplow;
    real k4low;
    real k3low;
    real k5low;
    real KIlow;
    
    real k5mean;
    real BPpmean;
    

    K1 = exp(logK1);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    vB = exp(logvB);

    // High
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    
    // Low
    BPplow = exp(logBPp + logBPpdiff);
    k4low = exp(logk4 + logk4diff);
    k5low = exp(logk5 + logk5diff);
    
    // Assumed to be indepenpendent of genotypes
    // note for myself: same no mather if mean(k5) or mean(k2)
    k5mean = (k5 + k5low)/2;
    BPpmean = (BPp + BPplow)/2;

    k2 = (K1 - k5mean * BPpmean)/Vnd;

    
    // High

    k3 = BPp * (k4 + k5)/Vnd;
    KI = K1 * k3 * k5 / (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5);
  
    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5)));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5)));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - Th1) - KI * Th2)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) + KI * Th1)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    
    // Low
    
    k3low = BPplow * (k4low + k5low)/Vnd;
    KIlow = K1 * k3low * k5low / (k2 * k4low + k2 * k5low + k3low * k5low);
    
    Th1low = 0.5 * (k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low + sqrt((k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4low + k2 * k5low + k3low * k5low)));
    Th2low = 0.5 * (k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low - sqrt((k2 + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4low + k2 * k5low + k3low * k5low)));

    Ph1low = (K1 * (k3low + k4low + k5low - Th1low) - KIlow * Th2low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph2low = (K1 * (Th2low - k3low - k4low - k5low) + KIlow * Th1low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph3low = KIlow;

    

    tcorr = time - t0;

  predhigh =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC off CND
      
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2,Ph3)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
        )
      ) 
      
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;
  
  predlow =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        )
      )
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;

  pred = ( prophigh * predhigh ) + ( proplow * predlow );

  return(pred);
}

real threetc5kP_log_stan_mix_BPp(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, real logk4,
                    real logk5, real logvB,
                    real logBPpdiff, real logk4diff, real logk5diff,
                    real prophigh, real proplow,
                    real time,
                    real t0,
                    real A, real B, real C,
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;

    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real Th1low;
    real Th2low;
    real Ph1low;
    real Ph2low;
    real Ph3low;

    real tcorr;

    real predhigh;
    real predlow;
    real pred;
    
    real BPplow;
    real k4low;
    real k3low;
    real k5low;
    real KIlow;
    

    K1 = exp(logK1);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    vB = exp(logvB);

    // High
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    k5 = exp(logk5);


    k2 = K1 / Vnd;
    k3 = (k4 * BPp)/Vnd;
    KI = k5;
  
    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4)^2 - 4 * k2 * k4));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4)^2 - 4 * k2 * k4));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 - Th1))/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4))/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    
    // Low
    BPplow = exp(logBPp + logBPpdiff);
    k4low = exp(logk4 + logk4diff);
    k5low = exp(logk5 + logk5diff);
    
    k3low = (k4low * BPplow)/Vnd;
    KIlow = k5low;
    
    Th1low = 0.5 * (k2 + k3low + k4low - sqrt((k2 + k3low + k4low)^2 - 4 * k4low * k2));
    Th2low = 0.5 * (k2 + k3low + k4low + sqrt((k2 + k3low + k4low)^2 - 4 * k4low * k2));

    Ph1low = (K1 * (k3low + k4low - Th1low))/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph2low = (K1 * (Th2low - k3low - k4low))/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph3low = KIlow;

    

    tcorr = time - t0;

  predhigh =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC off CND
      
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2,Ph3)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
        )
      ) 
      
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;
  
  predlow =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        )
      )
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;

  pred = ( prophigh * predhigh ) + ( proplow * predlow );

  return(pred);
}

real threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp_k2(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, real logk4,
                    real logk5, real logvB,
                    real logBPpdiff, real logk4diff, real logk5diff, real logVnddiff,
                    real prophigh, real proplow,
                    real time,
                    real t0,
                    real A, real B, real C,
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;

    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real Th1low;
    real Th2low;
    real Ph1low;
    real Ph2low;
    real Ph3low;

    real tcorr;

    real predhigh;
    real predlow;
    real pred;
    
    real BPplow;
    real k4low;
    real k3low;
    real k5low;
    real KIlow;
    real k5mean;
    real Vndlow;
    real k2low;
    

    K1 = exp(logK1);
    vB = exp(logvB);

    // High
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    
    // Low
    BPplow = exp(logBPp + logBPpdiff);
    k4low = exp(logk4 + logk4diff);
    k5low = exp(logk5 + logk5diff);
    Vndlow = exp(logVnd + logVnddiff);
    
    // Assumed to be indepenpendent of genotypes
    // note for myself: same no mather if mean(k5) or mean(k2)
    // k5mean = (k5 +k5low)/2;
    // k2 = K1 / Vnd - k5mean;

    // High
    k2 = K1 / Vnd - k5;
    k3 = (k4 * (k2 + k5) * BPp)/K1;
    KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5);

    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2+k5)));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2+k5)));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - Th1) - KI * Th2)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) + KI * Th1)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    
    // Low
    k2low = K1 / Vndlow - k5low;
    k3low = (k4low * (k2low + k5low) * BPplow)/K1;
    KIlow = K1 * k5low / (k2low + k5low);
    
    Th1low = 0.5 * (k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low - sqrt((k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * k4low * (k2low + k5low)));
    Th2low = 0.5 * (k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low + sqrt((k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * k4low * (k2low + k5low)));

    Ph1low = (K1 * (k3low + k4low + k5low - Th1low) - KIlow * Th2low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph2low = (K1 * (Th2low - k3low - k4low - k5low) + KIlow * Th1low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph3low = KIlow;
    

    tcorr = time - t0;

  predhigh =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC off CND
      
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2,Ph3)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
        )
      ) 
      
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;
  
  predlow =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        )
      )
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;

  pred = ( prophigh * predhigh ) + ( proplow * predlow );

  return(pred);
}
                    
real threetc5kS_log_stan_mix_BPp_k2(real logK1, real logVnd, real logBPp, real logk4,
                    real logk5, real logvB,
                    real logBPpdiff, real logk4diff, real logk5diff, real logVnddiff,
                    real prophigh, real proplow,
                    real time,
                    real t0,
                    real A, real B, real C,
                    real alpha, real beta, real gamma,
                    real ti, real bloodval) {

    real K1;
    real k2;
    real k3;
    real k4;
    real k5;
    real KI;
    real Vnd;
    real BPp;
    real vB;

    real Th1;
    real Th2;
    real Ph1;
    real Ph2;
    real Ph3;
    
    real Th1low;
    real Th2low;
    real Ph1low;
    real Ph2low;
    real Ph3low;

    real tcorr;

    real predhigh;
    real predlow;
    real pred;
    
    real BPplow;
    real k4low;
    real k3low;
    real k5low;
    real KIlow;
    real Vndlow;
    real k2low;
    
    // real k5mean;
    // real BPpmean;
    

    K1 = exp(logK1);
    vB = exp(logvB);

    // High
    BPp = exp(logBPp);
    k4 = exp(logk4);
    k5 = exp(logk5);
    Vnd = exp(logVnd);
    
    // Low
    BPplow = exp(logBPp + logBPpdiff);
    k4low = exp(logk4 + logk4diff);
    k5low = exp(logk5 + logk5diff);
    Vndlow = exp(logVnd + logVnddiff);
    
    // Assumed to be indepenpendent of genotypes
    // note for myself: same no mather if mean(k5) or mean(k2)
    // k5mean = (k5 + k5low)/2;
    // BPpmean = (BPp + BPplow)/2;

    
    // High

    k2 = (K1 - k5 * BPp)/Vnd;
    k3 = BPp * (k4 + k5)/Vnd;
    KI = K1 * k3 * k5 / (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5);
  
    Th1 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5)));
    Th2 = 0.5 * (k2 + k3 + k4 + k5 - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 * k5)));

    Ph1 = (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - Th1) - KI * Th2)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph2 = (K1 * (Th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) + KI * Th1)/(Th2 - Th1);
    Ph3 = KI;
    
    
    // Low
    
    k2low = (K1 - k5low * BPplow)/Vndlow;
    k3low = BPplow * (k4low + k5low)/Vndlow;
    KIlow = K1 * k3low * k5low / (k2low * k4low + k2low * k5low + k3low * k5low);
    
    Th1low = 0.5 * (k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low + sqrt((k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * (k2low * k4low + k2low * k5low + k3low * k5low)));
    Th2low = 0.5 * (k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low - sqrt((k2low + k3low + k4low + k5low)^2 - 4 * (k2low * k4low + k2low * k5low + k3low * k5low)));

    Ph1low = (K1 * (k3low + k4low + k5low - Th1low) - KIlow * Th2low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph2low = (K1 * (Th2low - k3low - k4low - k5low) + KIlow * Th1low)/(Th2low - Th1low);
    Ph3low = KIlow;

    

    tcorr = time - t0;

  predhigh =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC off CND
      
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2,Ph3)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3)
        )
      ) 
      
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;
  
  predlow =  
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             // Before t0 equal to 0

      // 2TC
        // Before t0+ti
        (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        ) +

        // After t0+ti
        (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low) -
            Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma,
                           Th1low, Th2low, Ph1low, Ph2low, Ph3low)
        )
      )
  ) +
  // Blood contribution
  vB *  bloodval;

  pred = ( prophigh * predhigh ) + ( proplow * predlow );

  return(pred);
}

"
```

##### Functions

```{r}
Integral_Feng_3TC5K <- function(t, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                 Th1, Th2, Ph1, Ph2, Ph3) {

  (B*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph3)/alpha^2 + (C*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph3)/alpha^2 + (A*(-1 + exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph3)/alpha^3 + 
  (B*(-1 + exp(-(beta*t)))*Ph3)/beta^2 + (C*(-1 + exp(-(gamma*t)))*Ph3)/gamma^2 + (A*Ph3*t)/alpha^2 - (B*Ph3*t)/alpha + (B*Ph3*t)/beta - 
  (C*Ph3*t)/alpha + (C*Ph3*t)/gamma - (A*Ph3*(1 - (1 + alpha*t)/exp(alpha*t)))/alpha^3 - (A*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph1)/(alpha*(alpha-Th1)^2) - 
  (A*Ph1*(1 - (1 + alpha*t)/exp(alpha*t)))/(alpha*(alpha-Th1)^2) + (B*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph1)/(alpha*(alpha - Th1)) + 
  (C*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph1)/(alpha*(alpha - Th1)) + (A*(1 - exp(-(t*Th1)))*Ph1)/((alpha-Th1)^2*Th1) - 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(t*Th1)))*Ph1)/((alpha - Th1)*Th1) - (C*(1 - exp(-(t*Th1)))*Ph1)/((alpha - Th1)*Th1) + (B*(1 - exp(-(t*Th1)))*Ph1)/((beta - Th1)*Th1) + 
  (C*(1 - exp(-(t*Th1)))*Ph1)/((gamma - Th1)*Th1) + (A*Ph1*(1 - (1 + alpha*t)/exp(alpha*t))*Th1)/(alpha^2*(alpha-Th1)^2) + 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(beta*t)))*Ph1)/(beta*(-beta + Th1)) + (C*(1 - exp(-(gamma*t)))*Ph1)/(gamma*(-gamma + Th1)) - 
  (A*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph2)/(alpha*(alpha-Th2)^2) - (A*Ph2*(1 - (1 + alpha*t)/exp(alpha*t)))/(alpha*(alpha-Th2)^2) + 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph2)/(alpha*(alpha - Th2)) + (C*(1 - exp(-(alpha*t)))*Ph2)/(alpha*(alpha - Th2)) + 
  (A*(1 - exp(-(t*Th2)))*Ph2)/((alpha-Th2)^2*Th2) - (B*(1 - exp(-(t*Th2)))*Ph2)/((alpha - Th2)*Th2) - (C*(1 - exp(-(t*Th2)))*Ph2)/((alpha - Th2)*Th2) + 
  (B*(1 - exp(-(t*Th2)))*Ph2)/((beta - Th2)*Th2) + (C*(1 - exp(-(t*Th2)))*Ph2)/((gamma - Th2)*Th2) + 
  (A*Ph2*(1 - (1 + alpha*t)/exp(alpha*t))*Th2)/(alpha^2*(alpha-Th2)^2) + (B*(1 - exp(-(beta*t)))*Ph2)/(beta*(-beta + Th2)) + 
  (C*(1 - exp(-(gamma*t)))*Ph2)/(gamma*(-gamma + Th2))
  
}
```

Function to prepare the data for plotting (see nls fit for single TACs):

```{r}
plot_fit <- function(pet, region, data, fit) {
  
  preddata <- tibble(
    frame_mid = seq(min(data$frame_mid),
                max(data$frame_mid),
                length.out=1000)
  ) %>% 
    mutate(meanblood = approx(data$frame_mid, data$meanblood, xout = .$frame_mid)$y) %>% 
    mutate(TAC = predict(fit, newdata=list(frame_mid = .$frame_mid,
                                           meanblood = .$meanblood)))

  
  ggplot(data, aes(x=frame_mid, y=TAC)) +
    geom_point(aes(size=weights)) +
    geom_line(colour="red", data=preddata) +
    labs(title = paste0(pet, ": ", region,",Type: ", data$genotype))
  
}
```

```{r}
simba_prior_threetc5k <- c(
  
  set_prior("normal(-2, 0.5)", nlpar = "logK1"),
```

### 5.2 ND 

#### 5.2.1 NLS

###### Function

```{r}
Model_FengConv_3TC5kND <- function(time, t0, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, ti, 
                               bloodval, 
                               logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,logk5, logvB) {
  
  
  K1 = exp(logK1)
  Vnd = exp(logVnd)
  BPp = exp(logBPp)
  k4 = exp(logk4)
  k5 = exp(logk5)
  vB = exp(logvB)
  
  k2 = K1 / Vnd -k5
  k3 = BPp * k4 * (k2 + k5)/K1
  
  th1 <- ((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5) - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2 + k5))) / 2

  th2 <- ((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5) + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * k4 * (k2 + k5))) / 2
  
  ph1 <- (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - th1) - th2 * K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5))/(th2 - th1)
  
  ph2 <- (K1 * (th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) - th1 * K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5))/(th2 - th1)
  
  ph3 <- K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5)
  
  tcorr <- time - t0
  
  # 2TC contribution
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             # Before t0 equal to 0
      
      # Before t0+ti
      (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(     
        Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3)
      ) +
        
      # After t0+ti 
      (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (   
        Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3) -
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3)
      )
    )
  ) +
  # Blood contribution
  vB*bloodval
  
}
```


###### Fitting

```{r, eval=FALSE}
plan(multicore, workers = 8) # Run this in parallel across 6 cores.

modeldat_nested <- simba_modeldata %>% 
  group_by(pet, region) %>% 
  nest() %>%  
  ungroup() %>% # We need to ungroup before running the parallel functions with future_map
    mutate(fit = future_map(data, ~nls.multstart::nls_multstart(
      TAC ~ Model_FengConv_3TC5kND(frame_mid, t0, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, ti,  #t_tac, t0
                               meanblood, 
                               logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4, logk5, logvB), data = .x,
      start_lower = c(logK1=-3.5, logVnd=0, logBPp=0, logk4=-5, logk5=-7.5, logvB=-3.5),
      start_upper = c(logK1=0, logVnd=3, logBPp=4, logk4=-1, logk5=-1, logvB=-2.5),
      lower = c(logK1=-3.5, logVnd=-2.5, logBPp=-2, logk4=-5, logk5=-7.5, logvB=-3.5),
      upper = c(logK1=0, logVnd=1, logBPp=4, logk4=-1, logk5=-1, logvB=-2.5),
      modelweights = weights, iter=20, supp_errors = "Y")))


saveRDS(modeldat_nested, "../DerivedData/nlsfitsND.rds")
```

#### 5.2.2 One Tac Bayesian

```{r, eval=TRUE}
set.seed(1337)

threetc5kND_prior <- c(
  set_prior("normal(-2, 0.5)", nlpar = "logK1"),
  set_prior("normal(-0.3, 0.5)", nlpar = "logVnd"),
  set_prior("normal(0.7, 0.5)", nlpar = "logBPnd"),
  set_prior("normal(-3, 0.5)", nlpar = "logk4"),
  set_prior("normal(-4, 1)", nlpar = "logk5"),
  set_prior("normal(-3, 0.25)", nlpar = "logvB"),
  
  set_prior("normal(0, 1)", dpar = "sigma", coef="sqrtinvw"))


threetc5kND_fit_formula <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kND_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                                                  logk5, logvB, 
                                                  frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
     sigma ~ 0 + sqrtinvw,
     # Nonlinear variables
     logK1 + logVnd + logBPnd + logk4 + logk5 + logvB ~ 1,
     # Nonlinear fit
     nl = TRUE)

get_prior(threetc5kND_fit_formula, data=dat_i, family = gaussian())

make_stancode(threetc5kND_fit_formula,
  family=gaussian(), 
  data = dat_i,
  prior = threetc5kND_prior,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan, 
                     block="functions"))


# get_prior(twotcm1k_fit_formula,
#   family=gaussian(), 
#   data = modeldat)


    
threetc5kND_fit <- brm(
  threetc5kND_fit_formula,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = dat_i,
  prior = threetc5kND_prior,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
             block="functions"),
  control = list(adapt_delta=0.90),
  chains = 2,
  cores = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  backend = "rstan", init = 0)

  

#summary(threetc5kND_fit)


```

```{r, eval=TRUE}
fitted <- fitted(threetc5kND_fit) %>%

  select(Estimate, 
         F_L95 = "Q2.5",
         F_U95 = "Q97.5")

dat_i_fitted <- dat_i %>%

  bind_cols(fitted)

ggplot(dat_i_fitted, aes(x=frame_mid, y=TAC)) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=P_L95, ymax=P_U95), alpha=0.1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=F_L95, ymax=F_U95), alpha=0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Estimate))
```

#### 5.2.3 Fixed genotype levels

##### Prep

```{r}
simba_fit_formula_3tc5kND_fixed <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kND_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                                                  logk5, logvB, 
                                                  frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|k|sub) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logBPnd ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c + genotype + 
                                         (1|k|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|k|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + genotype + (1|m|region) + (1|k|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + genotype + Age_dec_c + (1|k|sub) + 
                              (1|m|region) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_3tc5kND_fixed,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_fixed,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_3tc5kND_fixed, 
                          data = simba_modeldata_sub, 
                          family=gaussian(), 
                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_fixed)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

```{r}
                           alpha, beta, gamma, 
                           ti, meanblood),
  # Just intercepts for each parameter
  logK1 ~ 1 + region,
  logBPnd ~ 1 + region + genotype,
  logVnd ~ 1,
  logk4 ~ 1 + genotype,
  logk5 ~ 1 + genotype,
  logvB ~ 1,
  lf(sigma ~ 1),
  nl = TRUE
)


# First make the stanmodel
stanmodel <- brm(
  simba_fit_formula_simple,
  family = gaussian(), 
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_simple,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan, 
                     block = "functions"),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  empty = TRUE
)

# Get the compiled model and data
stan_mod <- stanmodel$model
stan_data <- make_standata(simba_fit_formula_simple, 
                           data = simba_modeldata_sub,
                           family = gaussian(),
                           prior = simba_prior_simple)

# Compile the model
stan_mod_compiled <- stan_model(model_code = stan_mod)

# Then optimize
fit_opt <- optimizing(stan_mod_compiled, data = stan_data, init = 0)

fit_opt$par
```

##### Plot genotype difs: epred PET

Here we have to average across regions because the pet effects are in pet:region

```{r}
fit <- fit_3tc5kND_fixed
# Create PET x Region prediction data (keeping region information)
modelmat_pet_region <- fit$data %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  group_by(pet, region) %>% 
  dplyr::slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# Helper function to extract PET-level estimates (averaging over regions)
extract_pet_param <- function(fit, newdata, re_formula, nlpar, param_name) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit, 
                  newdata = newdata %>% as.data.frame(), 
                  re_formula = re_formula, 
                  nlpar = nlpar) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>% 
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>% 
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>% 
    left_join(newdata %>% 
                select(row_n, pet, sub, region, genotype, Age_dec_c), 
              by = "row_n") %>% 
    # Average across regions within each PET and posterior sample
    group_by(sample_n, pet, sub, genotype, Age_dec_c) %>% 
    summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # Summarise across posterior samples
    group_by(pet, sub, genotype, Age_dec_c) %>% 
    summarise("{param_name}_mean" := mean(value),
              "{param_name}_q2.5" := quantile(value, 0.025),
              "{param_name}_q97.5" := quantile(value, 0.975),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")))
}
```

#### 5.2.4 Mixture

##### no Vnd genotype diff
###### Prep

```{r}
simba_modeldata <- simba_modeldata %>% 
  mutate(prophigh = case_when(
    genotype=="HAB" ~ 1,
    genotype=="MAB" ~ 0.5,
    genotype=="LAB" ~ 0,
  ),
  proplow = 1-prophigh)

simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp(
                                    logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
                                    logk5, logvB, 
                                    logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff,
                                    prophigh, proplow,
                                    frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + 
                                   logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
                                  (1|pet:region),
                              logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
                                         (1|sub) + (1|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + (1|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|region) + 
                                  (1|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              logBPpdiff ~ 1,
                              logk4diff ~ 1,
                              logk5diff ~ 1,
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)

# simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp(
#                                     logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
#                                     logk5, logvB, 
#                                     logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff,
#                                     prophigh, proplow,
#                                     frame_mid, 
#                                     t0, 
#                                     A, B, C, 
#                                     alpha, beta, gamma, 
#                                     ti, meanblood),
#                               lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
#                                    logInjRad_c + 
#                                    logdur_c +
#                                  (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
#                               # Nonlinear variables
#                               logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
#                                   (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
#                                          (1|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
#                                 (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logk4 ~ 1 + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
#                                 (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|m|region) + 
#                                   (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
#                               logBPpdiff ~ 1,
#                               logk4diff ~ 1,
#                               logk5diff ~ 1,
#                               # Nonlinear fit
#                               nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND, 
                          data = simba_modeldata, 
                          family=gaussian(), 
                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

###### Plot genotype difs: epred subject level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kND_fit4_BPp_complete_univariate_formulaVBPnew.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per subject ──────────────────────────────────────
modelmat_sub <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(region = NA, `pet:region` = NA) %>%
  group_by(sub) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar    = c("logK1", "logVnd", "logBPp", "logk4",      "logk5",     "logvB"),
  label    = c("K1",    "Vnd",    "BPp",    "k4",         "k5",        "vB"),
  diff_var = c(NA,      NA,       "logBPpdiff", "logk4diff", "logk5diff", NA)
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_sub %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = ~ (1 | sub),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_sub %>% select(row_n, sub, proplow), by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 6. Compute KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5) at draw level ───────────────────────
draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    # k2: genotype-independent, same in both excl and incl
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    k2      = exp(value_K1)/exp(value_Vnd)- k5mean,

    # k3: genotype-dependent
    k3_excl = exp(value_BPp) * exp(value_k4) * (k2 + exp(value_k5))/ exp(value_K1),
    k3_incl = exp(value_incl_BPp) * exp(value_incl_k4) * (k2 + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_K1),

    # KI: k2 is the same in both, k3/k4/k5 differ by genotype
    value      = log(exp(value_K1) * exp(value_k5) / (k2 + exp(value_k5))),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_K1) * exp(value_incl_k5) / (k2 + exp(value_incl_k5))),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_KI_K1 <- draws_KI %>%
  left_join(draws_all %>% 
              filter(parameter == "K1") %>%
              select(sample_n, sub, proplow, value_K1 = value),
            by = c("sample_n", "sub", "proplow")) %>%
  mutate(
    value      = value      - value_K1,
    value_incl = value_incl - value_K1,  # same value_K1 for both since K1 is genotype-independent
    parameter  = "KI/K1"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k2 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "k5", "BPp")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    value      = log(exp(value_K1)/ exp(value_Vnd) - k5mean),
    value_incl = value,
    parameter  = "k2"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k2 %>% 
  filter(sub == "B06") %>% 
  summarise(n_nan = sum(is.nan(value)),
            p_nan = mean(is.nan(value))*100)

draws_k2 %>% 
  summarise(n_nan = sum(is.nan(value)),
            p_nan = mean(is.nan(value))*100)

draws_k3 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1","Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    k2      = exp(value_K1)/exp(value_Vnd)- k5mean,
    
    value      = log(exp(value_BPp) * exp(value_k4) * (k2 + exp(value_k5))/ exp(value_K1)),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_incl_BPp) * exp(value_incl_k4) * (k2 + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_Vnd)),
    parameter  = "k3"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draws_combined <- bind_rows(draws_all, draws_KI, draws_KI_K1, draws_k2, draws_k3)

plot_data <- draws_combined %>%
  group_by(sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value,              na.rm = TRUE),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl,         na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "KI/K1", "k2","k3","vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# plot_data %>%
#   pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
#                names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
#   mutate(version = factor(version,
#                           levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
#                           labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
#                                      "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
#   geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
#   scale_y_log10() +
#   scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
#                                   "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
#   facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
#   labs(x       = "Genotype",
#        y       = "Parameter value",
#        colour  = NULL,
#        title   = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(legend.position = "bottom",
#         strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

p <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl. genotype diff",
                                     "Incl. genotype diff"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  # Lines connecting each subject's two points
  geom_line(aes(group = sub), alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

ggsave("genotypeDiff3tc5kND.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

diff_draws %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff),
               names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    Estimate = median(value),
    Q2.5     = quantile(value, 0.025),
    Q97.5    = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "log"),
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(PK_Parameter, "diff"),
    Genotype_Comparison = "HAB - LAB",
    across(c(Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5), ~100*(exp(.x)-1))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = Genotype_Comparison)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5), height = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ PK_Parameter, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "", x = "Difference (%)")
```

###### Plot genotype differences: PET level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kND_fit4_BPp_univariate_formulaVBPnew.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per PET x region ─────────────────────────────────
modelmat_pet_region <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(pet, region) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar      = c("logK1","logVnd","logBPp", "logk4","logk5","logvB"),
  label      = c("K1", "Vnd","BPp", "k4","k5","vB"),
  diff_var   = c(NA,NA,"logBPpdiff","logk4diff", "logk5diff",NA),
  re_formula = c("~(1|sub)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet)")
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var, re_formula) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_pet_region %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = as.formula(re_formula),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_pet_region %>% select(row_n, pet, sub, region, proplow),
              by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    # Average over regions within each PET x sample
    group_by(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow) %>%
    summarise(value       = mean(value),
              value_incl  = mean(value_incl),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 6. Compute KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5) at draw level ───────────────────────

draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    logk2_excl = value_K1      - value_Vnd,
    logk2_incl = value_incl_K1 - value_incl_Vnd,

    value      = log(exp(value_K1)      * exp(value_k5)      / (exp(logk2_excl) + exp(value_k5))),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_incl_K1) * exp(value_incl_k5) / (exp(logk2_incl) + exp(value_incl_k5))),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- bind_rows(draws_all, draws_KI) %>%
  filter(parameter != "k2") %>%
  group_by(pet, sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,      0.025),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,      0.975),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl, 0.025),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
                                     "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
                                  "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = "Genotype",
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = NULL,
       title  = "PET-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Identify subjects with repeated PETs
repeated_subs <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(sub, pet) %>%
  count(sub) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  pull(sub)

# Prepare long data with version as x-axis
plot_data_long <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl genotype diff",
                                     "Incl genotype diff")))

# Subset for repeated subjects only (for lines)
plot_data_repeated <- plot_data_long %>%
  filter(sub %in% repeated_subs)

ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data_repeated %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = log_mean) %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = c("Excl genotype diff", 
                                    "Incl genotype diff"),
                           names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
              mutate(version = factor(version,
                                      levels = c("Excl genotype diff",
                                                 "Incl genotype diff"))),
            aes(group = interaction(sub, pet)),
            alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", breaks = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "PET-level parameter estimates by genotype (repeated)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

###### Prep

```{r}
simba_modeldata <- simba_modeldata %>% 
  mutate(prophigh = case_when(
    genotype=="HAB" ~ 1,
    genotype=="MAB" ~ 0.5,
    genotype=="LAB" ~ 0,
  ),
  proplow = 1-prophigh)

# simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND_Vnddiff <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp_k2(
#                                     logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
#                                     logk5, logvB, 
#                                     logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff, logVnddiff,
#                                     prophigh, proplow,
#                                     frame_mid, 
#                                     t0, 
#                                     A, B, C, 
#                                     alpha, beta, gamma, 
#                                     ti, meanblood),
#                               lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
#                                    logInjRad_c + 
#                                    logdur_c +
#                                  (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
#                               # Nonlinear variables
#                               logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
#                                   (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
#                                          (1|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
#                                 (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logk4 ~ 1 + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
#                                 (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|m|region) + 
#                                   (1|l|pet:region),
#                               logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
#                               logBPpdiff ~ 1,
#                               logk4diff ~ 1,
#                               logk5diff ~ 1,
#                               logVnddiff ~ 1,
#                               # Nonlinear fit
#                               nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)

simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND_Vnddiff <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kND_log_stan_mix_BPp_k2(
                                    logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
                                    logk5, logvB, 
                                    logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff, logVnddiff,
                                    prophigh, proplow,
                                    frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + 
                                   logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
                                  (1|pet:region),
                              logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
                                         (1|sub) + (1|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + (1|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|region) + 
                                  (1|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              logBPpdiff ~ 1,
                              logk4diff ~ 1,
                              logk5diff ~ 1,
                              logVnddiff ~ 1,
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND_Vnddiff,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_Vnddiff,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kND_Vnddiff, 
                          data = simba_modeldata,

                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_Vnddiff)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

###### Plot genotype difs: epred subject level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/threetc5kND_fit_univariate_Vnddiff.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per subject ──────────────────────────────────────
modelmat_sub <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(region = NA, `pet:region` = NA) %>%
  group_by(sub) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept",
                                            "b_logVnddiff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept,
         logVnddiff = b_logVnddiff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar    = c("logK1", "logVnd", "logBPp", "logk4",      "logk5",     "logvB"),
  label    = c("K1",    "Vnd",    "BPp",    "k4",         "k5",        "vB"),
  diff_var = c(NA,      "logVnddiff",       "logBPpdiff", "logk4diff", "logk5diff", NA)
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_sub %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = ~ (1 | sub),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_sub %>% select(row_n, sub, proplow), by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 6. Compute KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5) at draw level ───────────────────────
draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    # k2: genotype-independent, same in both excl and incl
    #k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    k2_excl      = exp(value_K1)/exp(value_Vnd)- exp(value_k5),
    k2_incl = exp(value_K1)/exp(value_incl_Vnd)- exp(value_incl_k5),

    # k3: genotype-dependent
    k3_excl = exp(value_BPp) * exp(value_k4) * (k2_excl + exp(value_k5))/ exp(value_K1),
    k3_incl = exp(value_incl_BPp) * exp(value_incl_k4) * (k2_incl + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_K1),

    # KI: k2 is the same in both, k3/k4/k5 differ by genotype
    value      = log(exp(value_K1) * exp(value_k5) / (k2_excl + exp(value_k5))),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_K1) * exp(value_incl_k5) / (k2_incl + exp(value_incl_k5))),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_KI_K1 <- draws_KI %>%
  left_join(draws_all %>% 
              filter(parameter == "K1") %>%
              select(sample_n, sub, proplow, value_K1 = value),
            by = c("sample_n", "sub", "proplow")) %>%
  mutate(
    value      = value      - value_K1,
    value_incl = value_incl - value_K1,  # same value_K1 for both since K1 is genotype-independent
    parameter  = "KI/K1"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k2 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "k5", "BPp")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    value      = log(exp(value_K1)/ exp(value_Vnd) - exp(value_k5)),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_K1)/ exp(value_incl_Vnd) - exp(value_incl_k5)),
    parameter  = "k2"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k3 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1","Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    #k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    k2_excl      = exp(value_K1)/exp(value_Vnd)- exp(value_k5),
    k2_incl = exp(value_K1)/exp(value_incl_Vnd)- exp(value_incl_k5),
    
    value      = log(exp(value_BPp) * exp(value_k4) * (k2_excl + exp(value_k5))/ exp(value_K1)),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_incl_BPp) * exp(value_incl_k4) * (k2_incl + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_K1)),
    parameter  = "k3"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draws_combined <- bind_rows(draws_all, draws_KI, draws_KI_K1, draws_k2, draws_k3)

plot_data <- draws_combined %>%
  group_by(sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value,              na.rm = TRUE),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl,         na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "KI/K1", "k2","k3","vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# plot_data %>%
#   pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
#                names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
#   mutate(version = factor(version,
#                           levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
#                           labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
#                                      "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
#   geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
#   scale_y_log10() +
#   scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
#                                   "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
#   facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
#   labs(x       = "Genotype",
#        y       = "Parameter value",
#        colour  = NULL,
#        title   = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(legend.position = "bottom",
#         strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_Vnd <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl. genotype diff",
                                     "Incl. genotype diff"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  # Lines connecting each subject's two points
  geom_line(aes(group = sub), alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

ggsave("genotypeDiff3tc5kND.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

diff_draws %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff,logVnddiff),
               names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    Estimate = median(value),
    Q2.5     = quantile(value, 0.025),
    Q97.5    = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "log"),
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(PK_Parameter, "diff"),
    Genotype_Comparison = "HAB - LAB",
    across(c(Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5), ~100*(exp(.x)-1))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = Genotype_Comparison)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5), height = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ PK_Parameter, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "", x = "Difference (%)")
```

### 5.3 S 

#### 5.3.1 NLS

##### Function

```{r}
Model_FengConv_3TC5kS <- function(time, t0, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, ti, 
                               bloodval, 
                               logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,logk5, logvB) {
  
  
  K1 = exp(logK1)
  Vnd = exp(logVnd)
  BPp = exp(logBPp)
  k4 = exp(logk4)
  k5 = exp(logk5)
  vB = exp(logvB)
  
  k2 = (K1 - k5 * BPp) / Vnd
  k3 = BPp * (k4 + k5)/ Vnd
  
  th1 <- ((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5) + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 *k5))) / 2

  th2 <- ((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5) - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4 + k5)^2 - 4 * (k2 * k4 + k2 * k5 + k3 *k5))) / 2
  
  ph1 <- (K1 * (k3 + k4 + k5 - th1) - th2 * K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5))/(th2 - th1)
  
  ph2 <- (K1 * (th2 - k3 - k4 - k5) - th1 * K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5))/(th2 - th1)
  
  ph3 <- K1 * k3 * k5/ (k2*k4 + k2*k5 + k3*k5)
  
  tcorr <- time - t0
  
  # 2TC contribution
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             # Before t0 equal to 0
      
      # Before t0+ti
      (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(     
        Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3)
      ) +
        
      # After t0+ti 
      (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (   
        Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3) -
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3)
      )
    )
  ) +
  # Blood contribution
  vB*bloodval
}
```

#### 5.4.2 One TAC Bayesian

```{r, eval=TRUE}
set.seed(1337)

threetc5kS_prior <- c(
  set_prior("normal(-2, 0.5)", nlpar = "logK1"),
  set_prior("normal(-0.3, 0.5)", nlpar = "logVnd"),
  set_prior("normal(0.7, 0.5)", nlpar = "logBPnd"),
  set_prior("normal(-3, 0.5)", nlpar = "logk4"),
  set_prior("normal(-4, 1)", nlpar = "logk5"),
  set_prior("normal(-3, 0.25)", nlpar = "logvB"),
  
  set_prior("normal(0, 1)", dpar = "sigma", coef="sqrtinvw"))


threetc5kS_fit_formula <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kS_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                                                  logk5, logvB, 
                                                  frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
     sigma ~ 0 + sqrtinvw,
     # Nonlinear variables
     logK1 + logVnd + logBPnd + logk4 + logk5 + logvB ~ 1,
     # Nonlinear fit
     nl = TRUE)

get_prior(threetc5kS_fit_formula, data=dat_i, family = gaussian())

make_stancode(threetc5kS_fit_formula,
  family=gaussian(), 
  data = dat_i,
  prior = threetc5kS_prior,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan, 
                     block="functions"))


# get_prior(twotcm1k_fit_formula,
#   family=gaussian(), 
#   data = modeldat)


    
threetc5kS_fit <- brm(
  threetc5kS_fit_formula,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = dat_i,
  prior = threetc5kS_prior,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
             block="functions"),
  control = list(adapt_delta=0.90),
  chains = 2,
  cores = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  backend = "rstan", init = 0)
```
