#### 5.3.3 Fixed genotype levels

##### Prep

```{r}
simba_fit_formula_3tc5kS_fixed <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kS_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                                                  logk5, logvB, 
                                                  frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|k|sub) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logBPnd ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c + genotype + 
                                         (1|k|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|k|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + genotype + (1|m|region) + (1|k|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + genotype + Age_dec_c + (1|k|sub) + 
                              (1|m|region) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_3tc5kS_fixed,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_fixed,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_3tc5kS_fixed, 
                          data = simba_modeldata_sub, 
                          family=gaussian(), 
                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_fixed)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

```{r}
# Simplified formula - intercepts only, no random effects
simba_fit_formula_simple <- bf(
  TAC ~ threetc5kS_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                           logk5, logvB, 
                           frame_mid, 
                           t0, 
                           A, B, C, 
                           alpha, beta, gamma, 
                           ti, meanblood),
  # Just intercepts for each parameter
  logK1 ~ 1 + region,
  logBPnd ~ 1 + region + genotype,
  logVnd ~ 1,
  logk4 ~ 1 + genotype,
  logk5 ~ 1 + genotype,
  logvB ~ 1,
  lf(sigma ~ 1),
  nl = TRUE
)

# First make the stanmodel
stanmodel <- brm(
  simba_fit_formula_simple,
  family = gaussian(), 
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_simple,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan, 
                     block = "functions"),

  empty = TRUE
)

# Get the compiled model and data

stan_data <- make_standata(simba_fit_formula_simple, 
                           data = simba_modeldata_sub,
                           family = gaussian(),
                           prior = simba_prior_simple)

# Compile the model
stan_mod_compiled <- stan_model(model_code = stan_mod)

# Then optimize
fit_opt <- optimizing(stan_mod_compiled, data = stan_data, init = 0)

fit_opt$par
```

##### Plot genotype difs: epred PET

Here we have to average across regions because the pet effects are in pet:region

```{r}
fit <- fit_3tc5kS_fixed
# Create PET x Region prediction data (keeping region information)
modelmat_pet_region <- fit$data %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  group_by(pet, region) %>% 
  dplyr::slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# Helper function to extract PET-level estimates (averaging over regions)
extract_pet_param <- function(fit, newdata, re_formula, nlpar, param_name) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit, 
                  newdata = newdata %>% as.data.frame(), 
                  re_formula = re_formula, 
                  nlpar = nlpar) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>% 
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>% 
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>% 
    left_join(newdata %>% 
                select(row_n, pet, sub, region, genotype, Age_dec_c), 
              by = "row_n") %>% 
    # Average across regions within each PET and posterior sample
    group_by(sample_n, pet, sub, genotype, Age_dec_c) %>% 
    summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # Summarise across posterior samples
    group_by(pet, sub, genotype, Age_dec_c) %>% 
    summarise("{param_name}_mean" := mean(value),
              "{param_name}_q2.5" := quantile(value, 0.025),
              "{param_name}_q97.5" := quantile(value, 0.975),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")))
}

# Extract all parameters
BPnd_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,
                                     re_formula = ~ (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet:region),
                                     nlpar = "logBPnd", param_name = "logBPnd")

k5_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,

                                   nlpar = "logk4", param_name = "logk4")

K1_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,

                                   nlpar = "logK1", param_name = "logK1")

Vb_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=12}
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Parameter value (natural scale)", 
       title = "All PETs vs repeated measurements by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

#### 5.3.4 Mixture

###### Prep

```{r}
simba_modeldata_sub <- simba_modeldata_sub %>% 
  mutate(prophigh = case_when(
    genotype=="HAB" ~ 1,
    genotype=="MAB" ~ 0.5,
    genotype=="LAB" ~ 0,
  ),
  proplow = 1-prophigh)

simba_fit_formula_threetc5kS <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kS_log_stan_mix_BPp(
                                    logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
                                    logk5, logvB, 
                                    logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff,
                                    prophigh, proplow,
                                    frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + 
                                   logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
                                         (1|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|m|region) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              logBPpdiff ~ 1,
                              logk4diff ~ 1,
                              logk5diff ~ 1,
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kS,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kS, 
                          data = simba_modeldata_sub, 
                          family=gaussian(), 
                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

###### Plot genotype difs: epred subject level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kS_fit4_BPp_univariate_formulaVBPnew.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per subject x PET ────────────────────────────────
modelmat_sub <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(region = NA, `pet:region` = NA) %>%
  group_by(sub, pet) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar    = c("logK1", "logVnd", "logBPp", "logk4",       "logk5",       "logvB"),
  label    = c("K1",    "Vnd",    "BPp",    "k4",          "k5",          "vB"),
  diff_var = c(NA,      NA,       "logBPpdiff", "logk4diff", "logk5diff",  NA)
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_sub %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = ~ (1 | sub),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_sub %>% select(row_n, sub, pet, proplow), by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 6. Compute derived parameters ────────────────────────────────────────────
draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    BPpmean = (exp(value_BPp) + exp(value_incl_BPp)) / 2,
    k2      = (exp(value_K1)  - k5mean * BPpmean)    / exp(value_Vnd),

    k3_excl = exp(value_BPp)      * (exp(value_k4)      + exp(value_k5))      / exp(value_Vnd),
    k3_incl = exp(value_incl_BPp) * (exp(value_incl_k4) + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_incl_Vnd),

    value      = log(exp(value_K1) * k3_excl * exp(value_k5)      / (k2 * exp(value_k4)      + k2 * exp(value_k5)      + k3_excl * exp(value_k5))),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_K1) * k3_incl * exp(value_incl_k5) / (k2 * exp(value_incl_k4) + k2 * exp(value_incl_k5) + k3_incl * exp(value_incl_k5))),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_KI_K1 <- draws_KI %>%
  left_join(draws_all %>%
              filter(parameter == "K1") %>%
              select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, value_K1 = value),
            by = c("sample_n", "sub", "pet", "proplow")) %>%
  mutate(
    value      = value      - value_K1,
    value_incl = value_incl - value_K1,
    parameter  = "KI/K1"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k2 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "k5", "BPp")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    BPpmean = (exp(value_BPp) + exp(value_incl_BPp)) / 2,
    k2_val     = (exp(value_K1) - k5mean * BPpmean) / exp(value_Vnd),
    value      = log(k2_val),
    value_incl = log(k2_val),
    parameter  = "k2"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k2 %>% 
  summarise(n_nan = sum(is.nan(value)),
            p_nan = mean(is.nan(value))*100)

draws_k3 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    value      = log(exp(value_BPp)      * (exp(value_k4)      + exp(value_k5))      / exp(value_Vnd)),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_incl_BPp) * (exp(value_incl_k4) + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_incl_Vnd)),
    parameter  = "k3"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, pet, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draws_combined <- bind_rows(draws_all, draws_KI, draws_KI_K1, draws_k2, draws_k3)

plot_data <- draws_combined %>%
  group_by(sub, pet, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,       0.025),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,       0.975),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl,  0.025),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl,  0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "KI/K1", "k2", "k3", "vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl. genotype diff",
                                     "Incl. genotype diff"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(sub, pet)), alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", breaks = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

ggsave("genotypeDiff3tc5kS.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

diff_draws %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff),
               names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    Estimate = median(value),
    Q2.5     = quantile(value, 0.025),
    Q97.5    = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "log"),
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(PK_Parameter, "diff"),
    Genotype_Comparison = "HAB - LAB",
    across(c(Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5), ~100*(exp(.x)-1))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = Genotype_Comparison)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5), height = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ PK_Parameter, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "", x = "Difference (%)")
```

###### Plot genotype differences: PET level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kS_fit4_BPp_univariate.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per PET x region ─────────────────────────────────
modelmat_pet_region <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(pet, region) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar      = c("logK1","logVnd","logBPp", "logk4","logk5","logvB"),
  label      = c("K1", "Vnd","BPp", "k4","k5","vB"),
  diff_var   = c(NA,NA,"logBPpdiff","logk4diff", "logk5diff",NA),
  re_formula = c("~(1|sub)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet)")
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var, re_formula) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_pet_region %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = as.formula(re_formula),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_pet_region %>% select(row_n, pet, sub, region, proplow),
              by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    # Average over regions within each PET x sample
    group_by(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow) %>%
    summarise(value       = mean(value),
              value_incl  = mean(value_incl),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 6. Compute KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5) at draw level ───────────────────────

draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    logk2_excl = value_K1      - value_Vnd,
    logk2_incl = value_incl_K1 - value_incl_Vnd,

    value      = log(exp(value_K1)      * exp(value_k5)      / (exp(logk2_excl) + exp(value_k5))),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_incl_K1) * exp(value_incl_k5) / (exp(logk2_incl) + exp(value_incl_k5))),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 6. Compute KI = K1*k3*k5 / (k2*k4 + k2*k5 + k3*k5) at draw level ────────
# k2 = K1 / Vnd  →  log(k2) = log(K1) - log(Vnd)
# k3 = (k4 * BPp) / Vnd

draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Derived rate constants
    k2_excl = exp(value_K1)      / exp(value_Vnd),
    k2_incl = exp(value_incl_K1) / exp(value_incl_Vnd),

    k3_excl = (exp(value_k4)      * exp(value_BPp))      / exp(value_Vnd),
    k3_incl = (exp(value_incl_k4) * exp(value_incl_BPp)) / exp(value_incl_Vnd),

    k4_excl = exp(value_k4),
    k4_incl = exp(value_incl_k4),

    k5_excl = exp(value_k5),
    k5_incl = exp(value_incl_k5),

    K1_excl = exp(value_K1),
    K1_incl = exp(value_incl_K1),

    # KI = K1 * k3 * k5 / (k2*k4 + k2*k5 + k3*k5)
    value      = log(K1_excl * k3_excl * k5_excl / (k2_excl*k4_excl + k2_excl*k5_excl + k3_excl*k5_excl)),
    value_incl = log(K1_incl * k3_incl * k5_incl / (k2_incl*k4_incl + k2_incl*k5_incl + k3_incl*k5_incl)),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- bind_rows(draws_all, draws_KI) %>%
  filter(parameter != "k2") %>%
  group_by(pet, sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,      0.025),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,      0.975),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl, 0.025),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
                                     "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
                                  "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = "Genotype",
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = NULL,
       title  = "PET-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Identify subjects with repeated PETs
repeated_subs <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(sub, pet) %>%
  count(sub) %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  pull(sub)

# Prepare long data with version as x-axis
plot_data_long <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl genotype diff",
                                     "Incl genotype diff")))

# Subset for repeated subjects only (for lines)
plot_data_repeated <- plot_data_long %>%
  filter(sub %in% repeated_subs)

ggplot(plot_data_long, aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  geom_line(data = plot_data_repeated %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = version, values_from = log_mean) %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = c("Excl genotype diff", 
                                    "Incl genotype diff"),
                           names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
              mutate(version = factor(version,
                                      levels = c("Excl genotype diff",
                                                 "Incl genotype diff"))),
            aes(group = interaction(sub, pet)),
            alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", breaks = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "PET-level parameter estimates by genotype (repeated)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
simba_modeldata_sub <- simba_modeldata_sub %>% 
  mutate(prophigh = case_when(
    genotype=="HAB" ~ 1,
    genotype=="MAB" ~ 0.5,
    genotype=="LAB" ~ 0,
  ),
  proplow = 1-prophigh)

simba_fit_formula_threetc5kS_Vnddiff <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kS_log_stan_mix_BPp_k2(
                                    logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
                                    logk5, logvB, 
                                    logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff, logVnddiff,
                                    prophigh, proplow,
                                    frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + 
                                   logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
                                         (1|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|m|region) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              logBPpdiff ~ 1,
                              logk4diff ~ 1,
                              logk5diff ~ 1,
                              logVnddiff ~ 1,
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kS_Vnddiff,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
```

####### Plot genotype difs: epred subject level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kS_fit4_BPp_univariate_formulaVBPnew_Vnddiff.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per subject ──────────────────────────────────────
modelmat_sub <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(region = NA, `pet:region` = NA) %>%
  group_by(sub) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept",
                                            "b_logVnddiff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept,
         logVnddiff = b_logVnddiff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar    = c("logK1", "logVnd", "logBPp", "logk4",      "logk5",     "logvB"),
  label    = c("K1",    "Vnd",    "BPp",    "k4",         "k5",        "vB"),
  diff_var = c(NA,      "logVnddiff",       "logBPpdiff", "logk4diff", "logk5diff", NA)
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_sub %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = ~ (1 | sub),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_sub %>% select(row_n, sub, proplow), by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 6. Compute KI = K1 * k5 / (k2 + k5) at draw level ───────────────────────
draws_KI <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    # k2: genotype-independent, same in both excl and incl
    #k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    k2_excl      = (exp(value_K1)- exp(value_k5) * exp(value_BPp))/exp(value_Vnd),
    k2_incl = (exp(value_K1)-exp(value_incl_k5) * exp(value_incl_BPp))/exp(value_incl_Vnd),

    # k3: genotype-dependent
    k3_excl = exp(value_BPp)      * (exp(value_k4)      + exp(value_k5))      / exp(value_Vnd),
    k3_incl = exp(value_incl_BPp) * (exp(value_incl_k4) + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_incl_Vnd),

    # KI: k2 is the same in both, k3/k4/k5 differ by genotype
    value      = log(exp(value_K1) * k3_excl * exp(value_k5) / (k2_excl * exp(value_k4)      + k2_excl * exp(value_k5)      + k3_excl * exp(value_k5))),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_K1) * k3_incl *exp(value_incl_k5) / (k2_incl * exp(value_incl_k4) + k2_incl * exp(value_incl_k5) + k3_incl * exp(value_incl_k5))),
    parameter  = "KI"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_KI_K1 <- draws_KI %>%
  left_join(draws_all %>% 
              filter(parameter == "K1") %>%
              select(sample_n, sub, proplow, value_K1 = value),
            by = c("sample_n", "sub", "proplow")) %>%
  mutate(
    value      = value      - value_K1,
    value_incl = value_incl - value_K1,  # same value_K1 for both since K1 is genotype-independent
    parameter  = "KI/K1"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k2 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1", "Vnd", "k5", "BPp")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    k5mean  = (exp(value_k5)  + exp(value_incl_k5))  / 2,
    value      = log((exp(value_K1)- exp(value_k5) * exp(value_BPp))/exp(value_Vnd)),
    value_incl = log((exp(value_K1)-exp(value_incl_k5) * exp(value_incl_BPp))/exp(value_incl_Vnd)),
    parameter  = "k2"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

draws_k3 <- draws_all %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("K1","Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5")) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = c(value, value_incl)) %>%
  mutate(
    value      = log(exp(value_BPp)      * (exp(value_k4)      + exp(value_k5))      / exp(value_Vnd),),
    value_incl = log(exp(value_incl_BPp) * (exp(value_incl_k4) + exp(value_incl_k5)) / exp(value_incl_Vnd)),
    parameter  = "k3"
  ) %>%
  select(sample_n, sub, proplow, parameter, value, value_incl)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draws_combined <- bind_rows(draws_all, draws_KI, draws_KI_K1, draws_k2, draws_k3)

plot_data <- draws_combined %>%
  group_by(sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value,              na.rm = TRUE),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl,         na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl,  0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl,  0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "KI/K1", "k2","k3","vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# plot_data %>%
#   pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
#                names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
#   mutate(version = factor(version,
#                           levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
#                           labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
#                                      "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
#   geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
#   scale_y_log10() +
#   scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
#                                   "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
#   facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
#   labs(x       = "Genotype",
#        y       = "Parameter value",
#        colour  = NULL,
#        title   = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(legend.position = "bottom",
#         strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

p <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl. genotype diff",
                                     "Incl. genotype diff"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  # Lines connecting each subject's two points
  geom_line(aes(group = sub), alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

ggsave("genotypeDiff3tc5kS.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
p

diff_draws %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff),
```

### 5.4 P 

#### 5.4.1 NLS

##### Function

```{r}
Model_FengConv_3TC5kP <- function(time, t0, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, ti, 
                               bloodval, 
                               logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,logk5, logvB) {
  
  
  K1 = exp(logK1)
  Vnd = exp(logVnd)
  BPnd = exp(logBPnd)
  k4 = exp(logk4)
  k5 = exp(logk5)
  vB = exp(logvB)
  
  k2 = K1 / Vnd
  k3 = BPnd * k4
  
  th1 <- ((k2 + k3 + k4) - sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4)^2 - 4 * k2 * k4)) / 2

  th2 <- ((k2 + k3 + k4) + sqrt((k2 + k3 + k4)^2 - 4 * k2 * k4)) / 2
  
  ph1 <- (K1 * (k3 + k4 - th1))/(th2 - th1)
  
  ph2 <- (K1 * (th2 - k3 - k4))/(th2 - th1)
  
  ph3 <- k5
  
  tcorr <- time - t0
  
  # 2TC contribution
  (1-vB) * (
    (tcorr > 0) * (             # Before t0 equal to 0
      
      # Before t0+ti
      (tcorr < ti)*(1/ti)*(     
        Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3)
      ) +
        
      # After t0+ti 
      (tcorr >= ti)*(1/ti)* (   
        Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3) -
          Integral_Feng_3TC5K(tcorr - ti, A, B, C, alpha, beta, gamma, 
                         th1, th2, ph1, ph2, ph3)
      )
    )
  ) +
  # Blood contribution
  vB*bloodval
  
}
```

#### 5.4.2 One TAC Bayesian

```{r, eval=TRUE}
set.seed(1337)

threetc5kP_prior <- c(
  set_prior("normal(-2, 0.5)", nlpar = "logK1"),
  set_prior("normal(-0.3, 0.5)", nlpar = "logVnd"),
  set_prior("normal(0.7, 0.5)", nlpar = "logBPnd"),
  set_prior("normal(-3, 0.5)", nlpar = "logk4"),
  set_prior("normal(-4, 1)", nlpar = "logk5"),
  set_prior("normal(-3, 0.25)", nlpar = "logvB"),
  
  set_prior("normal(0, 1)", dpar = "sigma", coef="sqrtinvw"))


threetc5kP_fit_formula <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kP_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                                                  logk5, logvB, 
                                                  frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
     sigma ~ 0 + sqrtinvw,
     # Nonlinear variables
     logK1 + logVnd + logBPnd + logk4 + logk5 + logvB ~ 1,
     # Nonlinear fit
     nl = TRUE)

get_prior(threetc5kP_fit_formula, data=dat_i, family = gaussian())

make_stancode(threetc5kP_fit_formula,
  family=gaussian(), 
  data = dat_i,
  prior = threetc5kP_prior,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan, 
                     block="functions"))


# get_prior(twotcm1k_fit_formula,
#   family=gaussian(), 
#   data = modeldat)


    
threetc5kP_fit <- brm(
  threetc5kP_fit_formula,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = dat_i,
  prior = threetc5kP_prior,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
             block="functions"),
  control = list(adapt_delta=0.90),
  chains = 2,
  cores = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  backend = "rstan", init = 0)

  

summary(threetc5kP_fit)


```

#### 5.4.3 Fixed genotype levels

##### Prep

```{r}
simba_fit_formula_3tc5kP_fixed <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kP_log_stan(logK1, logVnd, logBPnd, logk4,
                                                  logk5, logvB, 
                                                  frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|k|sub) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logBPnd ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c + genotype + 
                                         (1|k|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|k|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + genotype + (1|m|region) + (1|k|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + genotype + Age_dec_c + (1|k|sub) + 
                              (1|m|region) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_3tc5kP_fixed,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_fixed,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_3tc5kP_fixed, 
                          data = simba_modeldata_sub, 
                          family=gaussian(), 
                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k_fixed)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

##### Plot genotype difs: epred PET

Here we have to average across regions because the pet effects are in pet:region

```{r}
fit <- fit_3tc5kP_fixed
# Create PET x Region prediction data (keeping region information)
modelmat_pet_region <- fit$data %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  group_by(pet, region) %>% 
  dplyr::slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# Helper function to extract PET-level estimates (averaging over regions)
extract_pet_param <- function(fit, newdata, re_formula, nlpar, param_name) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit, 
                  newdata = newdata %>% as.data.frame(), 
                  re_formula = re_formula, 
                  nlpar = nlpar) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>% 
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>% 
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>% 
    left_join(newdata %>% 
                select(row_n, pet, sub, region, genotype, Age_dec_c), 
              by = "row_n") %>% 
    # Average across regions within each PET and posterior sample
    group_by(sample_n, pet, sub, genotype, Age_dec_c) %>% 
    summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>% 
    # Summarise across posterior samples
    group_by(pet, sub, genotype, Age_dec_c) %>% 
    summarise("{param_name}_mean" := mean(value),
              "{param_name}_q2.5" := quantile(value, 0.025),
              "{param_name}_q97.5" := quantile(value, 0.975),
              .groups = "drop") %>% 
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")))
}

# Extract all parameters
BPnd_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,
                                     re_formula = ~ (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet:region),
                                     nlpar = "logBPnd", param_name = "logBPnd")

k5_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,
                                   re_formula = ~ (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet:region),
                                   nlpar = "logk5", param_name = "logk5")

                                   re_formula = ~ (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet:region),
                                   nlpar = "logk4", param_name = "logk4")

K1_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,
                                   re_formula = ~ (1|sub) + (1|pet:region),
                                   nlpar = "logK1", param_name = "logK1")

Vb_pet_epred <- extract_pet_param(fit, modelmat_pet_region,

# Plotting with lines connecting repeated measurements within subjects
ggplot(Vnd_pet_epred, aes(x = genotype, y = exp(logVnd_mean))) +
```

```{r}
simba_modeldata_sub$P_U95 <- preds[,4]

simba_modeldata_sub$F_U95 <- fitted[,4]
simba_modeldata_sub$Estimate <- fitted[,1]
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
library(ggsci)

check_some_fits <- function(modeldat, sampleid) {

    checkdat <- modeldat %>%
        filter(pet == sampleid)

    ggplot(checkdat, aes(x=frame_mid, y=TAC, colour=region, fill=region)) +
        geom_point(colour="black", size=2) +
        geom_point(size=1.5) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=P_L95, ymax=P_U95), alpha=0.2, colour=NA) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=F_L95, ymax=F_U95), alpha=0.4, colour=NA) +
        geom_line(aes(y=Estimate)) +
        facet_wrap(~region, scales="free", ncol=3) +
        scale_colour_manual(values=pal_futurama()(12)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values=pal_futurama(alpha = 0.3)(12)) +
        labs(y=expression(paste("Radioactivity (kBq/cc)", sep="")),
             x="Time (min)",
             title = paste(sampleid, ":", checkdat$genotype[1]))

}

ids <- unique(simba_modeldata_sub$pet) #sample(unique(simba_modeldata$pet), 5)

map(ids, ~check_some_fits(simba_modeldata_sub, .x))
```


#### 5.4.4 Mix

##### Prep

```{r}
simba_modeldata_sub <- simba_modeldata_sub %>% 
  mutate(prophigh = case_when(
    genotype=="HAB" ~ 1,
    genotype=="MAB" ~ 0.5,
    genotype=="LAB" ~ 0,
  ),
  proplow = 1-prophigh)

simba_fit_formula_threetc5kP <- bf( TAC ~ threetc5kP_log_stan_mix_BPp(
                                    logK1, logVnd, logBPp, logk4,
                                    logk5, logvB, 
                                    logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff,
                                    prophigh, proplow,
                                    frame_mid, 
                                    t0, 
                                    A, B, C, 
                                    alpha, beta, gamma, 
                                    ti, meanblood),
                              lf(sigma ~ 1 + s(frame_mid) + logRegSize_c + 
                                   logInjRad_c + 
                                   logdur_c +
                                 (1 | region) + (1 | pet), center = FALSE),
                              # Nonlinear variables
                              logK1 ~ 1 + region + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logBPp ~  1 + region + Age_dec_c +
                                         (1|sub) + (1|l|pet:region),
                              logVnd ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk4 ~ 1 + (1|m|region) + (1|sub) +
                                (1|l|pet:region),
                              logk5 ~ 1 + Age_dec_c + (1|sub) + (1|m|region) + 
                                  (1|l|pet:region),
                              logvB ~ 1 + (1|sub) + (1|region) + (1|pet),
                              logBPpdiff ~ 1,
                              logk4diff ~ 1,
                              logk5diff ~ 1,
                              # Nonlinear fit
                              nl = TRUE, center = TRUE)
  

sc <- make_stancode(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kP,
  family=gaussian(),
  data = simba_modeldata_sub,
  prior = simba_prior_threetc5k,
  stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
                     block="functions"))

# writeLines(sc, "stancode_unmod_LL_2.stan")

stand <- brms::make_standata(simba_fit_formula_threetc5kP, 
                          data = simba_modeldata_sub, 
                          family=gaussian(), 
                          prior = simba_prior_threetc5k)

stand_list <- list()
for (t in names(stand)) {
  stand_list[[t]] <- stand[[t]]
}
```

```{r}
rm(fit4_threetc5kP)
job::job({

})
```

##### Plot genotype difs: epred subject level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kP_fit4_BPp_univariate.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per subject ──────────────────────────────────────
modelmat_sub <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(region = NA, `pet:region` = NA) %>%
  group_by(sub) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar    = c("logK1", "logVnd", "logBPp", "logk4",      "logk5",     "logvB"),
  label    = c("K1",    "Vnd",    "BPp",    "k4",         "k5",        "vB"),
  diff_var = c(NA,      NA,       "logBPpdiff", "logk4diff", "logk5diff", NA)
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_sub %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = ~ (1 | sub),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_sub %>% select(row_n, sub, proplow), by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 7. Summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

plot_data <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,       0.025),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,       0.975),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl,  0.025),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl,  0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# plot_data %>%
#   pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
#                names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
#   mutate(version = factor(version,
#                           levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
#                           labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
#                                      "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
#   geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
#   scale_y_log10() +
#   scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
#                                   "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
#   facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
#   labs(x       = "Genotype",
#        y       = "Parameter value",
#        colour  = NULL,
#        title   = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
#   theme_bw() +
#   theme(legend.position = "bottom",
#         strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

p <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excl. genotype diff",
                                     "Incl. genotype diff"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = version, y = exp(log_mean), colour = genotype)) +
  # Lines connecting each subject's two points
  geom_line(aes(group = sub), alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = NULL,
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = "Genotype",
       title  = "Subject-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

ggsave("genotypeDiff3tc5kP.pdf", plot = p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

diff_draws %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(logBPpdiff, logk4diff, logk5diff),
               names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    Estimate = median(value),
    Q2.5     = quantile(value, 0.025),
    Q97.5    = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(Parameter, "log"),
    PK_Parameter = str_remove(PK_Parameter, "diff"),
    Genotype_Comparison = "HAB - LAB",
    across(c(Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5), ~100*(exp(.x)-1))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = Genotype_Comparison)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5), height = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ PK_Parameter, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(y = "", x = "Difference (%)")
```

##### Plot genotype differences: PET level

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ── 0. Load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit <- readRDS("../DerivedData/pbr_threetc5kP_fit4_BPp_univariate.rds")

# ── 1. Model matrix: one row per PET x region ─────────────────────────────────
modelmat_pet_region <- fit$data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(pet, region) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(row_n = 1:n())

# ── 2. Genotype diff posteriors ───────────────────────────────────────────────
diff_draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = c("b_logBPpdiff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk4diff_Intercept",
                                             "b_logk5diff_Intercept")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(logBPpdiff = b_logBPpdiff_Intercept,
         logk4diff  = b_logk4diff_Intercept,
         logk5diff  = b_logk5diff_Intercept) %>%
  mutate(sample_n = 1:n())

# ── 3. Parameters to extract ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
params <- tibble(
  nlpar      = c("logK1","logVnd","logBPp", "logk4","logk5","logvB"),
  label      = c("K1", "Vnd","BPp", "k4","k5","vB"),
  diff_var   = c(NA,NA,"logBPpdiff","logk4diff", "logk5diff",NA),
  re_formula = c("~(1|sub)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet:region)",  "~(1|sub)+(1|region)+(1|pet)")
)

# ── 4. Extract draws per parameter ────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_param_draws <- function(nlpar, label, diff_var, re_formula) {
  
  posterior_epred(fit,
                  newdata    = modelmat_pet_region %>% as.data.frame(),
                  re_formula = as.formula(re_formula),
                  nlpar      = nlpar) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(sample_n = 1:n()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-sample_n, names_to = "row_n", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(row_n = as.numeric(str_remove(row_n, "V"))) %>%
    left_join(modelmat_pet_region %>% select(row_n, pet, sub, region, proplow),
              by = "row_n") %>%
    { if (!is.na(diff_var))
        left_join(., diff_draws %>% select(sample_n, all_of(diff_var)), by = "sample_n") %>%
        mutate(value_incl = value + proplow * .data[[diff_var]])
      else
        mutate(., value_incl = value)
    } %>%
    # Average over regions within each PET x sample
    group_by(sample_n, pet, sub, proplow) %>%
    summarise(value       = mean(value),
              value_incl  = mean(value_incl),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(parameter = label)
}

# ── 5. Extract all parameters at draw level ───────────────────────────────────
draws_all <- pmap_dfr(params, extract_param_draws)

# ── 7. Combine and summarise ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- draws_all %>%
  group_by(pet, sub, proplow, parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    excl_mean  = mean(value),
    excl_q2.5  = quantile(value,      0.025),
    excl_q97.5 = quantile(value,      0.975),
    incl_mean  = mean(value_incl),
    incl_q2.5  = quantile(value_incl, 0.025),
    incl_q97.5 = quantile(value_incl, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype  = case_when(
      proplow == 0   ~ "HAB",
      proplow == 0.5 ~ "MAB",
      proplow == 1   ~ "LAB"
    ),
    genotype  = factor(genotype,  levels = c("HAB", "MAB", "LAB")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("K1", "Vnd", "BPp", "k4", "k5", "KI", "vB"))
  )

# ── 8. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(excl_mean, incl_mean),
               names_to = "version", values_to = "log_mean") %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version,
                          levels = c("excl_mean", "incl_mean"),
                          labels = c("Excluding genotype differences",
                                     "Including genotype differences"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = exp(log_mean), colour = version)) +
  geom_beeswarm(cex = 2.5, size = 1.5, dodge.width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Excluding genotype differences" = "grey50",
                                  "Including genotype differences" = "steelblue")) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(x      = "Genotype",
       y      = "Parameter value",
       colour = NULL,
       title  = "PET-level parameter estimates by genotype") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

##### Predict

```{r}
job::job({
  priorfit <- brm(
    simba_fit_formula_threetc5kP,
    family=gaussian(),
    data = simba_modeldata_sub,
    prior = simba_prior_threetc5k,
    stanvars = stanvar(scode = three_compartment_5k_fengconv_stan,
               block="functions"),
    backend = "rstan", init = 0, iter = 100,
    chains=2, cores=5, seed = 753273, sample_prior = "only")

brms::expose_functions(priorfit, vectorize=TRUE, verbose = F,
                       show_compiler_warnings = F)
  
  preds <- predict(fit4_threetc5kP)
  fitted <- fitted(fit4_threetc5kP)
  looic <- loo(fit4_threetc5kP)
  
  saveRDS(preds, "../DerivedData/fit4_preds_threetc5kP_BPp_univariate.rds")
  saveRDS(fitted, "../DerivedData/fit4_fitted_threetc5kP_BPp_univariate.rds")
  saveRDS(looic, "../DerivedData/fit4_looic_threetc5kP_BPp_univariate.rds")
})
```

```{r}
preds <- readRDS("../DerivedData/fit4_preds_threetc5kP.rds")
fitted <- readRDS("../DerivedData/fit4_preds_threetc5kP.rds")
#ps_loo <- readRDS("../DerivedData/fit4_loo.rds")

simba_modeldata_sub$P_L95 <- preds[,3]
simba_modeldata_sub$P_U95 <- preds[,4]
simba_modeldata_sub$F_L95 <- fitted[,3]

```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
library(ggsci)

check_some_fits <- function(modeldat, sampleid) {

    checkdat <- modeldat %>%
        filter(pet == sampleid)

    ggplot(checkdat, aes(x=frame_mid, y=TAC, colour=region, fill=region)) +
        geom_point(colour="black", size=2) +
        geom_point(size=1.5) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=P_L95, ymax=P_U95), alpha=0.2, colour=NA) +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=F_L95, ymax=F_U95), alpha=0.4, colour=NA) +
        geom_line(aes(y=Estimate)) +
        facet_wrap(~region, scales="free", ncol=3) +
        scale_colour_manual(values=pal_futurama()(12)) +
        scale_fill_manual(values=pal_futurama(alpha = 0.3)(12)) +
        labs(y=expression(paste("Radioactivity (kBq/cc)", sep="")),
             x="Time (min)",
             title = paste(sampleid, ":", checkdat$genotype[1]))

}

ids <- unique(simba_modeldata_sub$pet) #sample(unique(simba_modeldata$pet), 5)

map(ids, ~check_some_fits(simba_modeldata_sub, .x))
```

# Model comparison

Here we will do model comparison using the pareto smoothed importance sampling using the leave-one out criterion.
This is embedded in the loo package:

## comparison 1
* 3tc5kND
* Vnd_diff (with and without limits)
* whole data set
* 

```{r}
loo_3tc5kND <- readRDS("../DerivedData/threetc5kND_looic_univariate_Vnddiff.rds")
loo_3tc5kND_Vnd_limits <- readRDS("../DerivedData/threetc5kND_looic_univariate_Vnddiff_limits.rds")

```
